title: Reading Drill — The Seed Swap Ledger
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: The Seed Swap Ledger
passages.body:
**A** At a seed exchange in Elm Grove, organisers sorted envelopes by plant name. When they discovered that two people used the same name for different varieties, they added a source label describing who had supplied each batch.

**B** The next change was a simple reservation system. Gardeners could take common seeds freely, but the group kept a waiting list for rare varieties. This left time to divide a small supply fairly.

**C** Several newcomers brought empty envelopes to the event because they wanted to participate without taking anything. The group put a box near the entrance and later reused the envelopes as dividers for the ledger.
